**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Northwind, so it sits at the **preferred** position:

- **Clause 12.3** affirmatively preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and confirms we have made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **Clause 2.1** confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and that declining to sign another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **Section 4** binds only signed Order Forms; nothing requires Affiliate demand to route through Brightline.
- **Clause 12.4** (Vendor shall not market a directly competing analytics service) is exclusivity in *our* favour — retained, not flagged.
- Other "exclusive" hits are unrelated (non-exclusive access licence in 13.1, exclusive-remedy carve-outs in 19/21/30, exclusive jurisdiction in 28.2).
